entities.name: Ojer Taq
entities.description: Chief deity of the Oltec and god of civilization, a triumvirate Deep God and child of Chimil.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: Deity whose children include the Deep Gods of Ixalan's Core.

entities.name: Ojer Axonil
entities.description: Sibling of Taq who pulled Taq out of the veil and rescued them from Aclazotz.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Betrayer who attempted to take Taq's life and was imprisoned by Axonil.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: People whose chief deity is Ojer Taq.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: People of whom Ojer Taq is patron.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: Shape-changing gods of Ixalan's Core, children of Chimil.

entities.name: Whispering War
entities.description: Conflict whose sounds drew Axonil into the Core.

entities.name: Temple of Civilization
entities.description: Largest temple in the Core, located in Oteclan.

events.summary: Axonil, drawn into the Core by the Whispering War, pulls his elder sibling Taq from the veil.
events.quote: he reached into the veil and pulled his elder sibling to his side

events.summary: Aclazotz attempts to take Taq's life; Axonil rescues them, takes the Betrayer's eye and imprisons him.
events.quote: Axonil rescued them, taking the Betrayer's eye and imprisoning him.
